# Selv et hul i jorden kræver viden.
Sand er ikke bare sand – vores produkter er fremstillet af forædlet kvartssand af højeste kvalitet, og det kræver erfaring, viden og passion. 
[ LÆS MERE ](https://dansand.dk/om-os/)
# 22 millioner års leveringstid.
Kvartssand er en værdifuld ressource, som danner grundlag for en lang række vigtige produkter i vores hverdag. [Her kan du se, hvor vores sand kommer fra.](https://dansand.dk/sand-viden/geologisk-set/22-millioner-aars-leveringstid/)
[ LÆS MERE ](https://dansand.dk/sand-viden/geologisk-set/22-millioner-aars-leveringstid/)
Kråseflint til høns, ænder og kalkuner
Fjerkræ kan ikke tygge deres mad, så de knuser deres mad i en særlig ekstra-mave kaldet kråsen. Alle fugle sluger derfor sten, grus og sand, og Dansands kvartssand er særligt velegnet som kosttilskud for småfugle.
Ballast til færger og skibe
Ballast i store skibe må gerne være let at pakke helt tæt, let at pumpe ind og samtidig formstabilt, så det ikke flytter sig ude på søen. I bunden af Molslinjens enorme hurtigfærger (og i mange andre større skibe) ligger der derfor adskillige tons kvartssand, som vi har leveret.
3D printning af huse
Man skulle tro, det var løgn, men det er det faktisk ikke: Der eksperimenteres i dag med udvikling af egentlig 3D-print af huse. Vores kvartssand er ideelt til formålet og bliver anvendt i de fleste pilotprojekter verden over.

# About us
Denmark’s leading specialist producer of sand products
![Dansand_13](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand_13-qbgh18hlg4t0h68m9c7daynrmzuqxu4pypfcjhpvps.png)1/3 of our production is exported
![Dansand_22](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand_22-qbgh18hlg4t0h68m9c7daynrmzuqxu4pypfcjhpvps.png)22 million years of geology
![Om_os](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Om_os-qbgh1bb40mwvg04isvf90fy5f5gukxfwz3dszblp74.png)20+ different sand blends
![Dansand_50](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand_50-qbgh18hlg4t0h68m9c7daynrmzuqxu4pypfcjhpvps.png)50+ years of experience
![Dansand-380a](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand-380a-qbgh16lx2gqftybckbe45z4ug840ifx9ag4dkxso28.jpg)500,000 tonnes of sand per year
We work to create unique and valuable solutions based on silica sand from the Central Jutland subsoil. Every year, we extract and produce 500,000 tonnes of refined silica sand in more than 20 different blends – plus a wide range of special products. Our products are used in construction, industry, sports facilities, playgrounds, for the do-it-yourself market and in the environmental sector.
The fine silica sand originates from a 22 million year old formation in the Central Jutland subsoil.
But sand is not just sand. Sand is a specialised product that requires knowledge. From the moment we extract the sand from the subsoil until it ends up as a finished product, it undergoes a number of technically demanding refining processes. We wash and grade the sand, dry and sift it in different fractions and in some cases also add additives to the sand.
In this way, we develop unique sand products that enable our customers to cast foundations for offshore wind turbines, purify drinking water, produce mortar for house construction, create world-class golf courses and sports stadiums or enjoy beautiful, weed-free paving joints on their patio.
Through experience, expertise and enthusiasm, we have established ourselves as the market’s preferred producer of refined silica sand – both for professional use and in the do-it-yourself market.
About a third of our revenue comes from exports to Germany, Austria, Norway, Sweden, England and the Netherlands.

# CSR
![](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/dansandreplacement.jpg)
For half a century, Dansand has created unique and valuable solutions based on silica sand. It has been our ambition to gain recognition as the market’s leading producer of refined silica sand products, while offering our employees a meaningful and attractive workplace.
Since our beginnings in 1971, we have been aware that we are an integral part of society, and that there is a social responsibility involved in running a business – a responsibility that we are happy to take on.
The world today faces challenges that can only be solved through joint efforts. In Dansand, we have carried out an analysis work to uncover the company’s impact on the outside world. Step by step, we have reviewed our value chain and identified four focus areas where we believe we can make a positive difference – now and in the future.
![Dansand_Kvartsand](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20210%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
##### Utilise silica sand to the maximum
A large part of the products that we all take for granted in everyday life are based on silica sand – from drinking water filters and offshore wind turbine foundations to white marking stripes on the roads. Silica sand is necessary for us to maintain and expand the modern infrastructure, and therefore we see it as one of our most important tasks to make optimal use of the deposits in the subsoil. We plan our extraction and production in such a way that all fractions of the raw sand are utilised to the maximum. Nothing is wasted.
![Dansand_Udforsk](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20210%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
##### Production with a focus on humans and on the environment
As a production company, we leave an environmental footprint. We are very aware of this and constantly try to minimise our negative impact. We work partly to manage our resource consumption and waste volumes properly and partly to reduce our energy consumption and associated CO2 emissions.
We have established a fine-mesh system for handling all waste, and we are constantly working to replace risky substances with environmentally friendly alternatives and phase out the use of virgin plastic in our packaging.
To reduce Dansand’s energy consumption, we have implemented a number of measures such as replacing all conventional light sources with LED lighting, and we are continuously phasing out energy-heavy production equipment in favour of more efficient models. But we are also working to find solutions that enable us to achieve new, long-term and ambitious goals for minimising our CO2 emissions for the benefit of our business and the world around us.
![Dansand_Skov](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20210%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
##### Plant forest and work for biodiversity
Over time our silica sand reserves will become depleted. It is important to make plans in advance in order to re-establish the areas from which we extract the sand. We do this in collaboration with nature conservation and forest management specialists as well as with the local community. In addition to re-establishing our own areas we also participate in local projects outside of our own area. We focus in particular on replanting forests with a high degree of biodiversity – to the benefit of plant life, animal life, humans and the ecological balance. 
## We offer a safe and secure workplace
Consideration for a safe working environment takes precedence over all other considerations in Dansand. Safety is a common concern and is thought of in all aspects of the work, from the idea to a project being hatched until the finished solution is implemented. We are constantly working to improve our procedures and continuously train all employees. The goal is 0 work accidents.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20391%20301%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
## Using UN sustainability goals as a framework
As the overall framework for our sustainability efforts, we have chosen the UN’s World Goals 12 and 15. The choice has fallen on these two goals, because they relate directly to Dansand’s core business. We are a production company as well as a raw material extractor that utilises the earth’s resources, and as such we have a duty to produce in a responsible manner and to leave a nature in balance for the next generations.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20180%20180%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)No. 15: Life on land
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20180%20180%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)No. 12: Responsible production and consumption

## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):
  * [Internet Explorer](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/17442/windows-internet-explorer-delete-manage-cookies#ie=ie-11)
  * [Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027947/microsoft-edge-delete-cookies)
  * [Mozilla Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/delete-cookies-remove-info-websites-stored)
  * [Google Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=en)
  * [Opera](https://help.opera.com/en/latest/web-preferences/#cookies)
  * [Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201265)
  * [Flash cookies](https://www.macromedia.com/support/documentation/en/flashplayer/help/settings_manager07.html)
  * [Apple](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT1677)
  * [Android](https://timeread.hubpages.com/hub/How-to-delete-internet-cookies-on-your-Droid-or-any-Android-device)

## Changing your consent
You can change your consent by either deleting cookies from your browser or by changing your original choice by clicking the link below:
[You can change your consent by clicking here](javascript:CookieConsent.renew\(\);)
Remember: If you use more than one browser, you must delete cookies in all of them.
## Do you have any questions?
If you have any comments or questions relating to our information and/or processing of personal data, please feel welcome to contact us. ## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

# Energy surcharges  

It requires energy to produce, and transport refined silica sand. At the same time, the world is affected by sharply fluctuating energy prices, which have an impact on our production and freight costs.
To compensate for the fluctuations, our goods and freight charges are each subject to an energy surcharge. Both types of surcharges are variable, which means that they are adjusted as market prices for energy rise and fall. On this page you can stay informed about the current energy surcharges, and gain insight into how we calculate them..
## Calculation of energy surcharges on goods
The energy surcharges are calculated as an average of the daily prices for natural gas, electricity and diesel oil over a seven-day period from Friday to Thursday. The calculation also includes production related energy and environmental surcharges imposed by our suppliers, as well as the average price of LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas). The LPG price is recorded once a month.

## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

# Data privacy information  

On this page, we would like to inform you about how your personal data is processed when you use our website.
## Data controller
The data controller responsible for this website is DANSAND A/S (Lervejdal 8b, Addit, 8740 Brædstrup, Denmark).
More information about our company and its authorised representatives can be found in the [legal notice](https://www.dansand.dk/en/servicenavi/colophon/ "Öffnet internen Link im aktuellen Fenster").
## Which data is processed?
### Legal bases for data processing
We process personal data on the following legal bases so that we can provide access to our website and the associated services:
  * **Consent** (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
  * For the **performance of contracts** (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
  * For purposes of our **legitimate interests**(Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
  * For compliance with a **legal obligation** (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR)


We will refer to the corresponding terms in connection with each type of processing so that you can determine the basis on which your personal data is processed.
If your personal data is processed on the basis of your **consent** , you have the right to **withdraw** this at any time with future effect.
If we process data on the basis of a **legitimate interest** , you as the data subject have the right to **object** to the processing of your personal data as set out in Art. 21 GDPR.
### Access data
When you visit our website, your personal data is processed so that the website con-tent can be displayed on your end device.
The IP address of the end device you are using is processed so that the website can be displayed in your browser. We also require further information about the browser used on your end device.
Data protection law requires us to guarantee the confidentiality and integrity of the personal data processed by our IT systems.
### SSL encryption
This website uses SSL encryption for security reasons and to ensure that confidential content such as queries sent to us in our capacity as the website operator is protected during transmission. You can recognise an encrypted connection from the lock symbol in the browser address line and the fact that the address changes from “http://” to “https://”. When SSL encryption is activated, the data you transmit to us cannot be read by any third party.
### Cookies
We use cookies on our website. Cookies are small text files that are transmitted through your browser and stored on your end device. Cookies are necessary for the provision of certain functions on our website.
We use session cookies which your browser deletes automatically as soon as you leave the website.
For web analysis purposes, we also use so-called persistent cookies which are not automatically deleted after you leave our website.
You can prevent cookies from being placed by adjusting your browser settings accordingly. However, please note that if you do so, your use of the functions on our website may be limited. Cookies do not install or execute programs or other applications on your computer.
Cookies are used to serve our legitimate interests. Our legitimate interest lies in making visits to our website user-friendly.
## Other services and plugins

Cookiebot is an online service that helps us use cookies and track them online in compliance with data protection legislation. When using the web service Cybot A/S (Havnegrade 39, 1058 Copenhagen, Denmark), your browser transmits personal data to the company named. The legal basis for the processing of this data is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is the error-free functioning of our website. This data is erased as soon as the purpose for which it was collected has been fulfilled. You have the right to **change** or **withdraw** your consent at any time.
### Web analysis
Provided you declare your consent on access, this website will use Google Analytics, a web analysis service provided by Google Ireland Limited. The operating standard used is Universal Analytics. This makes it possible to assign data, sessions and interactions on several devices to a single pseudonymous user ID, thus facilitating analysis of the user’s activities regardless of the device used.
The information generated by the cookie regarding your use of this website is usually transmitted to a Google server in the USA and stored there. However, as we have activated IP anonymisation on this website and concluded an appropriate contract processing agreement with Google, Google will first shorten your IP address within the European Union member states or in other states that are party to the Agreement on the European Economic Area. Only in exceptional cases will your full IP address be sent to a Google server in the USA and shortened there.
Google is certified in accordance with the so-called “Privacy Shield” (list entry). Google guarantees an appropriate level of data protection.
You can prevent the data generated by the cookie regarding your use of the website (including your IP address) from being sent to and processed by Google by down-loading and installing the browser plug-in available at the following link <https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout?hl=uk>.
Alternatively, you can prevent your data from being collected by Google Ana-lytics – particularly in the case of mobile end devices – by clicking on the fol-lowing link: <https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout>. An opt-out cookie will then be placed on your device which will prevent your data from being col-lected on future visits to this website.

## Your rights as the data subject
You have the right to **obtain** information about which of your personal data is being processed. You are welcome to contact us at any time if you require this information.
Please note that if your request for information is not submitted in writing, we may re-quest proof from you that you are the person whom you claim to be.

Should statutory retention obligations exist, the data may only be erased once the respective statutory retention period has expired.

We revise this data privacy information whenever changes are made to this website and on other occasions when this is required. You will invariably find the current ver-sion on this web page.

## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

# Fakta om råstofindvinding ved Addit Syd
![Dansand-Addit-syd-03a](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand-Addit-syd-03a-qxo9imsihrjz4i0erhhgyyvdy4k6kaqemugyf38r00.jpg)
Råstoffer har en afgørende betydning for det moderne samfund. Når vi fx kører i bil til arbejde, lægger nyt tag på huset eller drikker rent vand fra hanen, bruger vi råstoffer. 
Region Midtjylland har ansvaret for råstofforsyningen i vores del af landet, og den 20. november 2024 vedtog regionsrådet Råstofplan 2020. 
Her blev 24 hektar i Addit Syd udlagt som råstofgraveområde, hvilket betyder, at arealet blev reserveret til råstofindvinding. 
Arealet tilhører selskabet K3L ApS, som er ejet af Dansand og Dansk Kvarts Industri.
Her på siden kan du finde vigtige fakta om råstofindvindingen i Addit Syd. Du kan blandt andet få indsigt i, hvordan indvindingen vil skride frem, og hvordan vi vil reetablere arealerne til et attraktivt naturområde.
Reetableringen vil ske løbende. Vi venter ikke, til vi er helt færdige med at grave. 
## Tidslinje for råstofindvinding og reetablering af Addit Syd
## Når man indvinder råstoffer, er der mange forskellige faktorer, der kan have indvirkning på fremdriften. Derfor er alle årstal vejledende og et udtryk for vores bedste vurdering.
2018
K3L køber 59 hektar i Addit Syd
For at sikre den fremtidige forsyning af kvartssand i Region Midtjylland køber 3KL 59 hektar jord i Addit Syd. Området er beliggende på matriklerne 27 g Sdr. Vissing By, Sdr. Vissing, 1q Sdr. Vissing by, Sdr. Vissing med flere.
2024
Region Midtjylland vedtager Råstofplan 2020
Planen sætter de overordnede rammer for råstofindvindingen i Region Midtjylland. Som et led i regionens ansvar for at sikre langsigtet tilgængelighed af samfundsnødvendige råstoffer udlægger regionen 24 hektar i Addit Syd til graveområde. 
2025
Ansøgning om gravetilladelse
For at kunne indvinde råstoffer i et graveområde er det nødvendigt at have en specifik tilladelse, nemlig en gravetilladelse. Den ansøger K3L Region Midtjylland om.
I ansøgningen beskriver vi vores planer for indvinding, drift og reetablering af de 24 hektar, herunder også vores strategi for at tage hensyn til miljøet, naturen, lokalområdet og fortidsminder.
I forlængelse af ansøgningen udarbejder en rådgiver en miljøkonsekvensrapport (Vurderinger af Virkninger på Miljøet, VVM). Rapporten sikrer, at alle miljømæssige aspekter i forbindelse med indvindingen bliver grundigt undersøgt. 
2025-2027
Sagsbehandling - gravetilladelse
Region Midtjylland behandler ansøgningen om gravetilladelsen. I denne proces undersøger regionen en lang række forhold, herunder miljø, natur, grundvand og naboer. Resultatet af undersøgelserne bestemmer de krav, regionen stiller til os i gravetilladelsen. 
### **Tilladelsen indeholder**
• vilkårene for indvinding og drift, fx hensyn natur og grundvand og fastlæggelse af arbejdstider 
• vilkårene for reetablering af området, fx krav til beplantning
Inden den endelige afgørelse sender regionen gravetilladelsen i høring hos alle relevante interessenter, herunder områdets naboer og Horsens Kommune.
2028
Indvinding og drift
Vi kan sandsynligvis påbegynde indvinding og drift**.**
Vi bevæger os gradvist frem fra nord mod syd. Det vil sige, at vi åbner et mindre areal på 2-4 hektar op ad gangen og indvinder først på land og derefter med sandsuger under grundvandsspejlet.
Råstofloven lægger op til, at indvinder nyttiggør råstofforekomsterne optimalt. Ved både at tørgrave og suge udnytter vi ressourcerne bedst muligt og begrænser de arealer, hvor der indvindes råstoffer.
Reetablering
Vi reetablerer løbende
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20820%20615%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Vi venter ikke til, at vi er færdige med at grave, men reetablerer løbende området i Addit Syd. 
### Ny skov
Vi kommer blandt andet til at plante 36 hektar ny skov. Det vil være et af de krav, som myndighederne stiller til os. I princippet kan vi rejse den nye skov et hvilket som helst sted i Danmark, men vi har altid et ønske om at genplante i vores lokalområde, så vi kan bevare og forbedre naturen, der hvor vi arbejder.
### Store klare søer
Med tiden vil der opstå store, klarvandede søer i forbindelse med vores aktiviteter. Råstofsøer er kendt for, at de har en god biologisk tilstand, og at de bidrager til en øget biodiversitet. Søvandet indeholder fx mindre kvælstof end "almindelige" søer, og vandet er klart, så lyset kan trænge helt ned på søbunden. Det skaber gode vækstbetingelser for undervandsplanter.
Du kan læse mere om miljøkvaliteten af råstofsøer i disse to rapporter: 
[Konsekvenser for grundvandskvaliteten ved råstofindvinding under grundvandsspejlet (se specielt tabel 1, s. 55)](https://vand-og-jord.dk/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/vj215-raastofindvinding-under-grundvand-52.pdf)
[Danske råstofsøer - vandkvalitet og biologisk tilstand](https://dce2.au.dk/pub/sr235.pdf)
### Bonusinfo
Helt generelt kan tidligere (og aktive) råstofgrave bidrage til en øget biodiversitet i Danmark, fordi naturen adskiller sig fra det traditionelle landskab. [Det kan du læse mere om her](https://www.regioner.dk/media/14977/dr_raastofredegoerelse_web_opslag.pdf)
## Sand Viden om råstofindvinding i Addit Syd
Kvartssandet i Addit er unikt og stammer fra en forekomst, der er 22 mio. år gammel. Sandet har nogle særlige egenskaber, som gør det til en uundværlig ingrediens i flere industrier. Herunder finder du nogle vigtige fakta om emnet.
### Hvor stort er området?
K3L ApS ejer 59 hektar skov i Addit Syd. Heraf er cirka 24 hektar udlagt som graveareal. På cirka 75 % af arealet vokser der nåletræer. 
### Er skoven fredet?
Cirka 56 hektar er udlagt som fredskov. Fredskov betyder ikke, at skoven er fredet, men at den skal plejes, fx med udtynding i bevoksningerne. Hvis træerne er hugstmodne, må de fældes og bruges til fx tømmer. Hvis fredskoven fældes, skal der plantes halvanden gange det fældede areal.
###  Eksporterer Dansand det meste af sit sand til udlandet? 
‘Nej’, Dansand eksporterer cirka 16 % af de mængder (tons sand), som vi producerer. 
### Leverer vi kvartssand til alle typer opgaver?
‘Nej’, hos Dansand er vi selektive i forhold til de formål, som vi lader sandet indgå i. For eksempel leverer vi ikke til almindelige bygge- og anlægsopgaver. Her kan sand, der er 12-15.000 år gammelt, anvendes. Dette sand findes i det meste af Danmark.
### Hvorfor graver vi under grundvandsspejlet? 
Råstofloven lægger op til, at indvinder nyttiggør råstofforekomsterne optimalt, og ved både at tørgrave og suge udnytter vi ressourcerne bedst muligt og begrænser de arealer, hvor der indvindes råstoffer.
### Påvirker vi drikkevandet? 
‘Nej’, det gør vi ikke. Når vi indvinder kvartssand under grundvands­spejlet, arbejder vi kun i det sekundære grundvandsmagasin. 
Det sekundære grund­vandsmagasin ligger forholdsvist tæt ved jordoverfladen, og det er ikke her vores drikkevand kommer fra. Det hentes længere nede i jorden i det primære grundvandsmagasin, som er beskyttet af en tyk og tætsluttende lermenbran.
## Vores kvartssand indgår i
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20500%20500%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Uundværlige byggematerialer. Når vi bygger supersygehuse, støber fundamenter til havvindmøller eller udfører andre vigtige bygge- og anlægsprojekter, bruger vi højstyrkebeton, mørtel og tørbeton. Den vigtigste ingrediens i disse materialer er kvartssand. Slutprodukterne skal leve op til strenge sikkerheds- og kvalitetskrav, og det er kun muligt, hvis det sand, der blandes i materialerne, er helt rent, har højt kvartsindhold og en nøjagtig kornkurve.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20500%20500%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Støberi- og metallurgiindustrien, som fremstiller mange af de produkter, vi tager for givet i hverdagen – fra komponenter til biler til nogle af de mange silikoneprodukter, som vi bruger i hjemmet, sundhedssektoren og bygeriet.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20500%20500%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Brøndboring og i filtre til vandrensning i vandværker og rensningsanlæg. Fordi sandet er helt rent og har den rette kornkurve kan det fjerne partikler og optage urenheder fra vandet, inden det pumpes ud til forbrugerne eller ledes ud i vandmiljøet.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20500%20500%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Fugematerialer, som forlænger levetiden på belægninger. Det kræver penge og CO2 at anlægge nye terrasser, indkørsler, carporte og gangarealer, og derfor er det vigtigt, at de kan holde i mange år. Dansands fugematerialer stabiliserer og beskytter de kostbare belægningssten mod, sætningsskader, ukrudt, trafik og en række af de andre påvirkninger, der kan ødeægge stenene.
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20500%20500%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Produkter til anlæg og pleje af grønne og rekreative arealer, fx fodboldbaner, golfbaner, legepladser og sandkasser, plantning af træer i byrummet og anlæg af blomsterbede i fx rundkørsler, ved offentlige institutioner og i parker.

  * [Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027947/microsoft-edge-delete-cookies)
  * [Mozilla Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/delete-cookies-remove-info-websites-stored)
  * [Google Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=en)
  * [Opera](https://help.opera.com/en/latest/web-preferences/#cookies)
  * [Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201265)
  * [Flash cookies](https://www.macromedia.com/support/documentation/en/flashplayer/help/settings_manager07.html)

## Changing your consent
You can change your consent by either deleting cookies from your browser or by changing your original choice by clicking the link below:
[You can change your consent by clicking here](javascript:CookieConsent.renew\(\);)
Remember: If you use more than one browser, you must delete cookies in all of them.
## Do you have any questions?
If you have any comments or questions relating to our information and/or processing of personal data, please feel welcome to contact us. The cookie policy itself is updated once a month by [Cookie Information](https://cookieinformation.com/). If you have any questions about our cookie policy, you are welcome to [contact Cookie Information on their website.](https://cookieinformation.com/)

## Working at Dansand
Honesty, care, community spirit and progress are the values that bind us together in Dansand. We want to create an exciting, challenging and above all safe workplace. For decades, we have worked with automation and digitization of our production processes and with creating a safe and secure working environment. Result: Happy colleagues who are proud to be employed by Dansand.
We are 40 employees engaged in production, maintenance, product development, sales, marketing and administration. Our employees are experienced, competent and have extensive knowledge of our processes and products. We continuously train apprentices and students and are constantly working to develop our specialist knowledge.
If we do not have a vacancy that suits you, you are welcome to send an unsolicited application to info@dansand.dk.

## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):
  * [Internet Explorer](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/17442/windows-internet-explorer-delete-manage-cookies#ie=ie-11)
  * [Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027947/microsoft-edge-delete-cookies)
  * [Mozilla Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/delete-cookies-remove-info-websites-stored)
  * [Google Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=en)
  * [Opera](https://help.opera.com/en/latest/web-preferences/#cookies)
  * [Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201265)
  * [Flash cookies](https://www.macromedia.com/support/documentation/en/flashplayer/help/settings_manager07.html)
  * [Apple](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT1677)
  * [Android](https://timeread.hubpages.com/hub/How-to-delete-internet-cookies-on-your-Droid-or-any-Android-device)

## Changing your consent
You can change your consent by either deleting cookies from your browser or by changing your original choice by clicking the link below:
[You can change your consent by clicking here](javascript:CookieConsent.renew\(\);)
Remember: If you use more than one browser, you must delete cookies in all of them.
## Do you have any questions?
If you have any comments or questions relating to our information and/or processing of personal data, please feel welcome to contact us. # History
![Topfoto](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Topfoto-qbgh1d747p4pcqlpo09wdio3v1dppde7rb2qsvio4w.jpg)
Each year Dansand produces 380,000 tons of silica sand for four different business areas: industry & construction, sports & leisure, environmental protection and the do-it-yourself market.
We are present in almost 3000 DIY stores across Europe, and about half of the turnover derives from export to a number of local markets – including Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Norway, Sweden and the UK.
We are about 40 employees in production, product development, sales and administration.
Dansand A / S is owned by PKB Holding (50%) and Belgian Sibelco (50%), the world’s largest supplier of minerals.
1971
Poul Erik Beck founds Silbeko
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%201170%20800%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Poul Erik Beck founds Silbeko, later Silkeborg Kvartssand A / S. Since the beginning of the 60's, Poul Erik Beck has overseen the family business and haulage business Jens Konrad. The company owns several gravel pits, including the pit in Addit, which contains a unique reserve of "white" sand. The sand is of such a high quality that it can be used as an ingredient in industry. But sand is not just sand. Different customers and different industries place different demands on the composition of the material, and Poul Erik Beck sees potential in creating a new type of silica sand-based products. The idea is to separate the raw sand, wash and dry it and put together the special sand fractions that the industry demands.
In collaboration with the Danish Technological Institute and a small group of employees, Poul Erik Beck is working intensively to develop a product range that meets the specifications of the Danish foundry industry.
1972
Leading supplier
The company becomes the leading supplier of silica sand to the Danish foundry industry. The development work has created a knowledge base that makes it possible to live up to the foundries' very specific quality requirements. The collaboration with the foundry industry also opens the doors to several other markets such as the concrete and mortar industry.
1985
Silkeborg Kvartssand
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%201170%20762%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Silkeborg Kvartssand gets its first order for top dressing for a Danish golf club. Up through the 80s, the company begins collaborating with more and more golf clubs who see the value in nurturing their courses with a quality sand product.
At the same time, the business area is expanded to also include the supply of silica sand-based products for football clubs, riding arenas, playgrounds and leisure institutions.
1986
Changes name to Dansand A / S
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%201202%20186%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Silkeborg Kvartssand A / S changes its name to Dansand A / S. The same year, the company buys Lund Kvartsværk, including the plant's production facilities and bagging machines. The purchase makes it possible to deliver sand in bags directly from our own factory.
1993
Victor Jensen
The daily operation of the company is handed over to new CEO Victor Jensen. Poul Erik Beck continues in his role as chairman of Dansand’s board of directors.
1998
Sibelco
Dansand sells 50% of its shares to S. C. R. Sibelco Group, which is the world's largest supplier quartz of minerals.
1999
Søby Værk
Dansand acquires Søby Værk. 
2000
Poul Konrad Beck
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%203840%202561%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Poul Erik Beck's son, Poul Konrad Beck, takes over the management of Dansand. The Board of Directors and the new Executive Board are initiating a radical modernization of the company. All processes that can be automated are automated, and over the next 15 years, Dansand will invest massively in the latest production technology on the market.
2001
Optiroc
Dansand acquires Weber Saint-Gobain's sand production in Silkeborg (at the time Optiroc). The plant is operated locally in Silkeborg until the following year, when all local production units are transferred to the headquarter in Addit.
2002
Addit
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%201170%20759%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Production and administration are gathered in the newly built domicile in Addit. We have built a new factory with some of the market's most advanced production equipment, including robot-operated packaging lines and digitally controlled washing plants and drying ovens, which employees can operate from home. We can now produce 24/7 without the employees having to go to work at odd times of the day.
Dansand buys Weber's sand production in Silkeborg (Optiroc)
2004
Joint filling sand products
Joint filling sand products
Dansand launches the first joint filling sand products for the DIY and retail market. Initially, the products will be sold on the Danish market.
2007
Grejsdalens Filterværk
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20768%20512%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Dansand buys Grejsdalen's Filterworks in Vejle
2008
DanGrit
Dansand acquires DanGrit's sand production in Varde. 
2009
The financial crisis
The financial crisis is raging, but the DIY products are now sold in DIY stores in Germany, Norway, the Netherlands, Belgium, and the United Kingdom. Despite the crisis, we are expanding the organization and creating an independent department for the DIY area with sales, complaint handling and marketing. So far, we have sold the products via distributors, but we want to put our own imprint on the market, partly by negotiating directly with the retail chains, partly by strengthening the DANSAND brand in the consumer segment.
2018
Unloading system
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20768%20512%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
We inaugurate our first fully automatic reading system. Here, mortar and concrete customers can pick up sand 24 hours a day without the involvement of Dansand's employees. It increases both our delivery capacity and gives drivers increased flexibility because they can pick up orders outside normal business hours.
2019
CEO
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20768%20512%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Poul Konrad Beck resigns as CEO of Dansand. Instead, he takes over the chairmanship of Dansand's board from Poul Erik Beck, who passes the baton on to the next generation. Thomas Steen Hansen becomes CEO of Dansand.
2021
Tandskov Gravel pit
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%201620%201080%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Dansand buys Tandskov Gravel Pit. There is a growing awareness in society that silica sand is a limited resource. Dansand wants to ensure that the silica sand deposit in the gravel pit is optimally utilized and is not used for purposes where a more common type of sand could have been used.
2001
50th anniversary
![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%204056%202705%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
Dansand celebrates its 50th anniversary. Over the course of 50 years, the company has evolved from operating a traditional sand gravel to being a specialized raw material company. Today, a third of Dansand's turnover derive from exports of highly processed products. However, these products make up only about 16 % of the quantities produced at Dansand. In 1971 Dansand’s most important asset was the white quartz sand, today it is the technical knowledge that is added to the products. The old formula, material + knowledge = value, is as relevant as it was in the early 70s.

Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

  * [Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027947/microsoft-edge-delete-cookies)

## Changing your consent
You can change your consent by either deleting cookies from your browser or by changing your original choice by clicking the link below:
[You can change your consent by clicking here](javascript:CookieConsent.renew\(\);)
Remember: If you use more than one browser, you must delete cookies in all of them.

If you have any comments or questions relating to our information and/or processing of personal data, please feel welcome to contact us. ## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

## What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small data file stored in your computer, tablet or smartphone. A cookie is not a program that can contain harmful malware or virus.
## How our website uses cookies
Some cookies perform essential functions for our website. Cookies also help us get an overview of your visit to our website so we can continuously optimize and tailor the experience to your needs and interests. For example, cookies remember things like the items added to the shopping cart; whether you have visited our website before; if you are logged in; and the specific language and currency you prefer to see on the website. We also use cookies to target our ads specifically to you on other websites. In general, we use cookies as part of our service to present you with content that is as relevant to you as possible.
You can see the specific services that store cookies and why they do it, under the different categories:
  1. Functional
  2. Statistical
  3. Marketing


## How long are cookies stored?
The length of time a cookie is stored on your devices and browsers varies. The lifetime is calculated according to your last visit to the website. When a cookie expires, it is automatically deleted. All our cookies’ lifetimes are specified in our cookie policy.
## How to block or delete cookies
You may at any time block all or just third-party cookies completely by changing the browser settings on your computer, tablet or smartphone. The location of these settings will depend on the browser you use. However, you should be aware that if you block all or just third-party cookies, there may be functions and services that you will be unable to use on the website (because these depend on cookies).  
[You can opt-out of cookies from Google Analytics here](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). 
## How can you delete cookies?
It is easy to delete cookies that you have previously accepted. It depends on which browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) and device (smartphone, tablet, PC, Mac) you are using.   
You can typically find this information under settings – Security and Privacy – but this may vary from one browser to another. Specify which device/browser you are using (click the appropriate link):

# Values
At Dansand, we strive to show our customers and partners the way to unique and valuable solutions based on quartz sand. But we also want to show the way when it comes to offering a good and meaningful workplace. That is why our everyday life is based on four core values. They are the compass that sets the direction for everything we do in Dansand – in everyday life and when long-term decisions have to be made.
![Dansand_Omhu](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand_Omhu-1-qbgh18hj0f8lmfskwdezwhn1ve6un1a89wn9v1ze9s.png)
## Care means that we  

  * do not compromise on safety
  * are concerned with creating quality
  * communicate carefully and precisely so everyone knows what they need to do
  * only deliver goods that are in order
  * learn from our mistakes and do not hide them
  * creates trust because you can count on the agreements you have with us
  * take care of the environment


![Dansand_Fremdrift](https://dansand.dk/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Dansand_Fremdrift-1-qbgh18hj0f8lmfskwdezwhn1ve6un1a89wn9v1ze9s.png)
## Progress means that we  

  * are constantly on the move, never being “satisfied”
  * become impatient when things go slowly
  * are first-movers
  * are not happy to be the best – we want to be better still
  * are robust to adversity
  * enjoy taking leadership


![Dansand_Fælles](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20210%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
## Togetherness means that we  

  * enjoy that we are not all alike
  * actively choose to cooperate
  * take care of each other
  * create trust
  * share successes
  * have respect for each other
  * do not bully each other
  * appreciate the value of the individual
  * have fun

###  [ The raw material tax is increased by 11 percent ](https://dansand.dk/the-raw-material-tax-is-increased-by-11-percent-2/?lang=en)
March 10, 2020 
On February 27 2020, the Danish parliament changed a number of laws relating to raw material taxes. These changes mean that the tax on raw materials will be raised by 11 percent over a five-year period.

## About DANSAND A/S
DANSAND A/S is a Danish company of the type Aktieselskab based in Brædstrup, founded in 1971. The company is registered under the industry Grus- og sandgravning og indvinding af ler og kaolin. The management consists of Thomas Steen Hansen. The company is owned by PKB HOLDING II ApS and SCR Sibelco NV. The company has 35 employees. In 2025, the company reported a gross profit of DKK 82,225,000 and a net result of DKK 34,790,000 compared with DKK 37,500,000 the year before. Equity amounted to DKK 137,469,000.
DANSAND A/S demonstrates a solid financial health with consistent profitability over the past few years. Gross profit has shown an upward trend, increasing from 59.15 million DKK in 2022 to 82.23 million DKK in 2025, while net profit also rose from 23.30 million DKK to 34.79 million DKK in the same period. The company's equity has significantly improved, reaching 137.47 million DKK in 2025, indicating a strong capital position. However, the lack of disclosed revenue figures limits a full assessment of its market position within the gravel and sand extraction industry. Overall, DANSAND A/S appears to be well-positioned for continued growth, bolstered by healthy profit margins and increasing equity.
